<p>At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious goal: to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together.</p> <p>40% of all food produced in the world is wasted. You will work towards specific outcomes with the freedom and responsibility to figure out the best way to achieve them together with your team. Your mission will be to help refine, design, implement, deliver, and maintain an international top-class product, ensuring quality, maintainability, and sustainability.</p> <h3><strong>The Tech Stack</strong></h3> <p>We have created a single-page React application localized into multiple languages with TypeScript, RTK Query, MUI, and react-router. <li>Actively participate in your team’s agile development processes with a continuous improvement mindset.</li> <li>Strive to deliver international top-class products with maximum quality, performance, maintainability, and accessibility.</li> <li>Take on additional tasks outside your current boundaries with help from your team to continue to grow and expand your skills.</li> </ul> and CSS/MUI.</li> <li>Deep understanding of React.js, its core principles (state, props, context, hooks), and modern architectural patterns.</li> <li>Experience with state management solutions (e.g., Redux / RTK Query, React Context API) and client-side routing.</li> <li>Experience with common frontend tooling, testing, and CI frameworks (e.g., Vite/Webpack, NPM, ESLint, Jest, Playwright).</li> <li>Proven success in building scalable, responsive visual interfaces with strong cross-browser compatibility and user experience design sensibilities.</li> <li>Familiarity with RESTful APIs, modern integration patterns, and code versioning tools like Git.</li> <li>Enjoys actively participating in a cross-functional product team and takes pride in writing clean, high-quality code.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Our Values</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>We win together:</strong> Food waste is a big beast to fight. We believe in a #oneteam.</li> <li><strong>We raise the bar:</strong> We always push for more. We do the right thing.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What We Have To Offer</strong></h3> <ul> <li>An opportunity to work in a global social-impact company and certified B Corporation! where you can see a real and tangible impact in your role.</li> <li>To be an integral member of our defined product teams. description_text: About the Job At Certivity, we are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (m/f/d) to join our Data team. You will design and build the services that extract structured data from regulatory documents, and the tooling that verifies this data is correct once it's in our systems. This is a chance to work on complex engineering challenges with massive real-world impact. You will work alongside a sharp, collaborative team and ship production systems end-to-end. If you are comfortable pairing with AI tools to write code and want to build systems that ingest, verify, and deliver data at scale, this role might be the right one for you. What you will do Build and scale services that extract structured data from regulatory documents. Design and maintain tooling to ensure data correctness across ingestion pipelines. Deploy and operate containerized apps in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Pair with AI coding tools as part of your regular development workflow. Contribute to technical architecture and help shape the engineering culture. Your profile 5+ years of professional software development experience. Strong skills in Python. "AI-native": comfortable and effective pairing with AI tools to write code. Hands-on experience with data extraction at scale. Senior-level experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure). Proficiency with Git, CLI tools, and containerized deployments (Docker). Clear communicator who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. Comfortable working hybrid in our Munich office. Nice to Have: Experience with regulatory or compliance data. Experience with ML pipelines or Large Language Models (LLMs). Full-stack skills (React, Angular, or Vue). Why us? A vibrant in-office culture in Munich with the option for up to 60 % work from home. Flexible working hours. 30 vacation days per year (including 4 “company rest days” over christmas). 30 days of "workation" per year, within the EU and selected countries. We are building the world's decision infrastructure: the strategic twin of every industrial organization for complex combinatorial problems. We unlocked what wasn't possible before: mapping reality with its levers and constraints into a computer, then running n-dimensional optimization on critical value-chain decisions. We help Europe stay strong and the German Mittelstand make good decisions between market shifts, orders, machines and people. Founded by Dana (CEO) and Erik (CTO) from RWTH research, backed by a €2.8M round led by Vorwerk Ventures, with customers live on our optimization models. We move fast. We care. No patience for problems left unsolved. Your mission Hi, I'm Erik, CTO of Circonomit. This ad is specific on purpose: you should be able to tell from it whether this is your job. We build decision infrastructure for industrial companies: our customers model their production, with its capacities, costs and constraints, and we compute the answer to "what should we do?" before the decision is made. Your mission: scale our data platform for multiple customers and domains. Customer data arrives in many formats from many sources, ERP exports included; it has to land in our system consistently, stay manageable at millions of records, and be fast to query when models and results are on-screen. The product is a data-heavy web app with a math-heavy backend (Python, TypeScript, Solid.js, Postgres, on Cloudflare): your center of gravity is data and infrastructure, but you touch the whole stack. We are looking for a system thinker who wants to shape the architecture. We will not sugarcoat it: short deadlines, real workload, and a platform that grows while customers already run on it. What you'll own The data platform end to end: ingestion, storage, and the query paths that keep millions of records fast on screen. You design it, you build it, you run it in production. The platform layer, directly with the CTO: infrastructure, deployments, and the path to production for the whole team. Performance and correctness work in the optimization engine, together with our research engineers. Your features from first line to production: nobody hands you a ticket and waits. How we work Small team, short lines of communication, no layers. You own your features end to end: you build them, you ship them to production yourself, you run them. Feedback runs both ways, and it runs continuously, in daily work and in weekly one-on-ones. We talk as equals. We communicate proactively and flag it early when something isn't working out. Saying no is part of the job. We like this work, and you'll notice. We review each other's code, and we like being together in the Cologne office, because the fastest conversations still happen in a room. Requirements 5+ years building production backend or data-intensive systems. Strong Python and solid TypeScript, with the appetite to work in both daily. Analytics-data experience: real SQL depth, plus any of Parquet/Arrow/DuckDB/dbt/warehouse internals. Production PostgreSQL (multi-tenant, migrations, performance). Data pipelines over heterogeneous sources (ERP exports, Excel, CSV) onto object storage (S3 or comparable), built to keep working as customers and formats grow. Distributed systems and API design: typical failure modes, HTTP/auth/caching, sane versioning and error behavior. Engineering craft: design patterns, CI/CD pipelines you set up yourself, prototypes you can throw away. You have worked in a team, not mostly alone, and you know from experience which agile practices carry their weight. You have experience working with Linear, Jira, or a similar project management tool. You communicate proactively, too much rather than too little, and you organize yourself and your work. German at C1 or better, and fluent English. Team life runs in German; code and docs are English. NRW-based (Cologne office), optionally Munich, Stuttgart, Berlin area or else willing to work hybrid. Open to find a way if we fit. Nice to have: a substantial migration you carried out end to end (system, stack, or data) · telemetry and observability · Cloudflare or comparable serverless infrastructure · frontend experience, ideally with Solid.js or another reactive framework · optimization/OR exposure · manufacturing or ERP data experience. You are structured and biased for action, and you have shown you play to win wherever life has put you so far. This role is not for you if you want a clearly defined box, or work handed to you in tickets. We are a small team, pre-Series A: structures and processes are still being built, by us and by you. Priorities shift with customers, and some weeks a deadline bends the plan. Benefits Impact.  You see your results in the real world, fast. The problems are concrete (production plans, capacities, logistics), and customers can measure in euros what your work changed. Ownership.  What you build, you ship, and you own it once it runs. No layers between you and production, no approval chain that turns your decision into someone else's. The people next to you.  You work directly with the CTO on the platform layer, and with the math and OR team on the optimization engine. Shaping.  The processes are still forming, and whoever shows up with a better way of doing things gets to install it. This is a place for system thinkers: the interesting part is seeing how the pieces fit and where they will break. The company is early, and your scope will grow with it. Feedback speed.  You will know where you stand. We say things out loud, we adjust, and we expect the same from you. description_text: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.&nbsp;</span></p></div><h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the Frontend Technologies domain within Marketplace. In this role, your mission will be two-fold:&nbsp;</p> <ol> <li><strong>Pivot our frontend setup for bigger efficiency</strong>: we have been operating in mostly the same frontend setup for at least 6 years, and recognize that change is imminent.</li> <li><strong>Drive strategic engineering initiatives</strong>: architect and implement platform-specific changes that enhance modularity, autonomy, resilience, and performance across Android, iOS, and Web.&nbsp;</li> </ol> <p>You will have to balance and prioritize foundational capabilities - such as Design Systems, CI/CD, Modularization, App Releases, Performance, and Global UI quality - to optimize both frontend developer velocity and user satisfaction.</p> <p>You will lead 4 Engineering Managers and 3 Staff Engineers and set and implement the FE strategy, which will impact the roadmaps of 9 Product domains within the Marketplace.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you will</strong></h2> <p><strong>Strategically:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Ensure the most effective frontend setup for the Marketplace.</strong> We have 40+ teams, each with 3 frontend engineers (iOS, Android, and Web) in the Marketplace unit. We know this will look different in two years. Deciding what different means, and getting 9 product domains to fund it, is the job</li> <li><strong>Drive Technology Strategy:</strong> Set and drive the future technology strategy for frontends, establishing a modular, scalable architecture that enables rapid development and strategic growth. Basically - raise the technological bar for all Marketplace unit.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Refine the domain's identity: </strong>Take sole ownership of shaping its future, successfully integrating Design Systems and engineering to treat our frontend platforms as a cohesive product.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Tactically</strong>:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead frontends:</strong> Lead a horizontal, platform-focused domain containing Android, iOS, Web, and Design System teams.</li> <li><strong>Lead Initiatives:</strong> Oversee Marketplace-wide technical tooling, core libraries, and frameworks. Lead strategic projects, i.e., frontend modularization and modernization (SwiftUI/Jetpack Compose), native automated testing.</li> <li><strong>Elevate global UI quality:</strong> Integrate design systems and accessibility into the frontend ecosystem to consolidate technical, visual and interaction quality standards. Support UI experimentation.</li> <li><strong>Ensure Resilience &amp; Reliability:</strong> Maintain robust release processes, Marketplace frontend quality, and performance monitoring to reduce downtime and ensure a consistent member experience.</li> <li><strong>Innovate &amp; Optimize:</strong> Drive AI-efficiency enablement in frontend development and explore cross-platform frontend development opportunities to increase engineering speed and productivity.</li> </ul> <p><strong>A lot of this work will be influencing without formal authority</strong>: Champion the frontend technical vision among your director peers, influencing the leaders of 9 Product domains to accommodate and prioritize platform-wide changes across 40+ teams.</p> <h2><strong>About you</strong></h2> <p><strong>How much of a technical acumen? </strong>Enough to have in depth conversations with our direct reports. You will have 4 strong technical EMs reporting to you, as well as 3 world-class staff engineers. We don’t think you need to match their technical competencies (that’s a stretch!), but you have to be able to speak their language, understand problems at their essence, and be able to consolidate and multiply their inputs, including being able to disagree objectively.</p> <p><strong>Leadership: </strong>you have a track record of making level change in the organizations that you lead (rather than 20% change). Consolidating your team views and making coherent strategy out of those views is step one. Step two is even more important: being able to implement these changes in your domain, and more so - across other domains in the marketplace - is a foundational ability you carry. In practice, that means you have at least 2 years of experience leading leaders and 5 years of experience influencing without authority.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Change horizon:</strong> You are comfortable holding two timeframes at once. We need someone who can say, "Here is what our frontend setup should look like in two years, and here is why" AND name the clear deliverable that has to ship in the first quarter to make that end state reachable. Leaders who only do the second are common. Leaders who only do the first are entertaining. We need both.</p> <p><strong>What this role is not:</strong> This is not a hands-on frontend or release-engineering role. You will not be tuning CI, owning the release train, or reviewing architecture decisions yourself — you’ll have 4 strong EMs and 3 Staff Engineers close to the details, and your job is to turn their technical judgment into direction, alignment, and organizational change. If your strongest work is deep in the mechanics, you'll be underused here. If your strongest work is changing how 40+ teams operate, you'll be busy.</p> <h2><strong>Work perks&nbsp; </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li>30 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>A daily lunch allowance</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>A subsidised gym membership with ClassPass or Urban Sports Club</li> <li>A subsidised pension plan provided by Vinted</li> <li>Hallesche Supplemental health insurance</li> <li>Life and disability insurance provided</li> <li>A subsidised Deutschlandticket</li> <li>The opportunity to spend up to 90 days per year - 21 of which can be spent working outside of the EU - on workation</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p><strong>Individual Learning Budget</strong></p> <p>We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid Work</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in the office are recommended but not enforced. It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity</strong></p> <p>The Vinted Group is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people from all walks of life feel a sense of belonging. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and life experiences. At Vinted, all applicants are treated fairly without regard to their race, age, religion or belief, sex, national origin, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">The annual gross salary range for this position is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€124.300</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>€168.100 EUR</span></div></div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

job_title: Flutter & Node.js Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d) - Fully Remote
description_text: memodio is a digital health application (DiGA) fighting forgetfulness and dementia 🧠 Our app is prescribed by doctors, fully reimbursed by German statutory health insurance, and recommended by leading medical associations. In a clinical trial with 140 participants, we showed that it measurably improves memory performance, everyday independence, and quality of life. More than 10,000 people already trust memodio. We've been on the market for over five years. So we have the speed and ownership culture of a startup, without the chaotic early days: a validated product, paying reimbursement partners, and real users who notice when we ship something good. Now we're growing the engineering team. Where you sit: anywhere in the world. We're a small distributed team, not a company with a remote policy bolted on. The one requirement is overlap: at least four hours of your working day between 09:00 and 18:00 Berlin time, because we solve problems together, not by throwing tickets over a wall. How you join us: as an employee or as a freelancer, whichever fits your situation better. Tell us which you'd prefer when you apply. Tasks Our core product is live and helping thousands of people, but it's far from finished. A big part of this role is evolving the existing app to better fit the people who actually use it: adults aged 50+, often dealing with early-stage cognitive decline. Every improvement you make has a direct, visible effect on someone's day. Beyond the core product we're building new and adjacent products, including ones with AI capabilities. If working with LLMs excites you, there's real room to shape that. If it doesn't, that's fine too. How the role works You won't get finished designs and implementation specs to execute. You'll get problems, context, and user needs and the freedom to figure out the best solution. That's deliberate: it's where the creativity and the ownership live. It also means the job asks you to think about what to build, not only how . Today our CTO is hands-on in the codebase, supported by a part-time engineer. You'd join as the next full-time engineer on a small team where your decisions carry real weight. Day to day Frontend: evolve our Flutter app (iOS & Android), with a strong focus on good UX and usability for people aged 50+ Backend: design and build our Node.js APIs and services for new features Product: work closely with our medical and product colleagues: your voice matters in what we build and how Quality: help us keep code review, testing, and engineering standards at the level a regulated medical product demands Optional: if DevOps interests you, there's room to shape our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and deployment but it isn't the core of the job Requirements What you bring 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, and we care far more about what you've actually shipped than about the number. Show us something you built Flutter/Dart skills, or a proven ability to ramp up fast (e.g. coming from React Native or native mobile) Working knowledge of Node.js and building APIs, you don't have to be equally strong on both ends, but you can't be mobile-only You work well remotely and asynchronously. This is a distributed role on a tiny team. You write clearly, you post updates without being asked, you unblock yourself, and you don't go quiet for two days At least four hours of daily overlap with 09:00–17:00 Berlin time (CET/CEST) You're comfortable working from underspecified problems. As a small company we can't hand you full designs and implementation plans — you'll need to ask the right questions, propose solutions, and make calls. In return, you get creative freedom A self-directed, structured way of working, you thrive with a lot of ownership and little supervision Dedication: we don't do inhumane startup hours, but when it matters - a release, a deadline, a critical fix Fluent English, written and spoken. German is a plus, not a requirement Nice to have, not required Interest or experience in software security, our product passed an intense security audit and we intend to keep that bar high Experience with accessibility, or with building for older users Experience with DiGA, medical devices, or other regulated environments Startup or consultancy background DevOps experience (CI/CD, cloud infrastructure) You are probably not right if You need a large team around you. For now it's you, a hands-on CTO, and a part-time engineer. Specialists to hand things off to come later, you'll help hire them You're looking for greenfield-only work. A big part of this job is improving a live product with real users and real constraints You need someone to hand you tickets, or a manager checking in daily. Remote and self-directed is the whole shape of this role You see your scope as highly specialised. We need technical solutions for internal tooling here and there too. If touching a HubSpot integration feels beneath you, this isn't the right place Benefits What we offer Purpose: your code measurably helps people — clinically proven, prescribed by doctors, reimbursed by statutory health insurance Real ownership: as the next full-time engineer, you'll own features end to end and have a direct say in how we build Stability with startup energy: 5+ years on the market, revenue from reimbursement partners Genuinely remote, genuinely worldwide: work from wherever you're based, with flexible hours around a light overlap window. Our office in Potsdam is there if you ever want it Your choice of setup: employment or freelance, whichever suits you No office politics: a small, focused team where the energy goes into the product, not into positioning Straight talk: you've just read our salary range and a list of reasons not to apply. That's how we operate internally too If you have any questions, please don't hestitate to reach out :) The initial phase will be a short questionnaire, followed by a small project and 1-2 live interview rounds.
